pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Free Plan: Supports up to 3 connected channels with 10 scheduled posts per channel… Essentials Plan: $5 per channel per month on annual billing, or $6 per channel on monthly billing. Team Plan: $10 per channel per month on annual billing, or $12 per channel on monthly billing"

plans.name: Free
plans.quota: Up to 3 channels, 10 scheduled posts per channel

nl.tagline: Eenvoudig social media inplannen, met AI-hulp bij posts
nl.description: Buffer plant posts in voor onder meer Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok en Facebook, met een AI-assistent voor ideeën en herformuleringen, en eenvoudige statistieken. Je betaalt per gekoppeld kanaal.
bestFor: Eenvoudig plannen zonder veel toeters en bellen
limitations: Gratis: 3 kanalen en 10 geplande posts per kanaal

en.tagline: Simple social media scheduling with AI help for posts
en.description: Buffer schedules posts for Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, Facebook and more, with an AI assistant for ideas and rewrites, plus simple analytics. You pay per connected channel.
notFor: Large teams with extensive reporting needs
limitations: Free: 3 channels and 10 scheduled posts per channel
